name: Warcaller's Chime of Refuge

source.title: Pathfinder #170: Spoken on the Song Wind

text: This chime's carvings depict a series of warding runes that evoke feelings of serene protection. When activated, you touch the chime to yourself or a willing creature. The target gains the effects of Sanctuary (DC 20 Will save save). You can use this chime up to five times per day, but each use must target a different creature.
